drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 64-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.84, creatinine 0.89, hemoglobin 13, pao2 54, platelets 293, sodium 141, wbc 9.6; vitals dbp 75-81, heart_rate 81-85, map 93-97, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-32, sbp 127-132, spo2 88-94, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 297, sodium 141, wbc 9.1; vitals dbp 75-81, heart_rate 80-85, map 93-98, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-25, sbp 129-133, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 64-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure, resolved. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
